classification.difficultyReason: Combine equal angles standing on the same arc with the angle in a semicircle and the angle sum of a triangle.

content.prompt: Find the values of the pronumerals.

spec.description: Unshaded circle with centre O on the diagonal diameter from the lower-left point to the upper-right point. Four circumference points and all five source chords are retained. The supplied 70° and unknown y are placed in their respective angle sectors. Decorative source colours are replaced by house black.
spec.mathematics: The 70° circumference angle subtends the chord joining the upper-right and bottom points. The angle at the lower-left endpoint of the diameter subtends that same chord and is 70°. The angle at the bottom point subtending the diameter is 90°, leaving y = 20°.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the given 70°, unknown y and centre label O are visible; the supplied answer is excluded from the question diagram.

answer.worked:
The angle at the lower-left point is $70^\circ$ because angles standing on the same arc are equal. The angle at the bottom point is $90^\circ$ because it stands on a diameter.
$$\begin{aligned}y+70^\circ+90^\circ&=180^\circ\\y&=20^\circ\end{aligned}$$
